inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Parent right to review video recordings of alleged incident of abuse or neglect involving parent child: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, operation did not share video footage of incident with parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parent right to review video recordings of alleged incident of abuse or neglect involving parent child (26 TAC §746.521(8))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, child was able to escape to the parking lot of the daycare without supervision or staff member intervening to ensure child?s safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: During inspection, one out of the four classrooms observed had diaper changing items in reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: During inspection, fire extingushers were not inspected monthly by director or designee for 2025 year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler: During inspection, one out of the two bottles observed did not have child's name.    Noted: Director labeled bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: During inspection, one out of the eight files observed. Caregiver conducted CPR training online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: During inspection, lock down drills had not been conducted or documented for 2025 year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: People list has not been validated since 10-31-2024.    Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Children were observed unsupervised while staff was outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization: Operation did not complete an incident report after being notified a child sustained an injury while in care and required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation's annual sanitation inspection is expired. The last inspection was conducted on 10/22/2022. The inspection documentation was requested by not submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Multiple electrical outlets were uncovered in the Two's classroom.     Note: Corrected when safety covers were added to the outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of eight children's files evaluated is missing immunization records on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The director's first aid certification expired on 11/10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: Four out of eight caregivers are missing training in the following topics:    -Emergency preparedness  -Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: The director's CPR certification expired on 11/10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant was missing current feeding instructions on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's annual fire inspection is expired. The last inspection was conducted on 9/1/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The play structure on the toddler playground is not level as it tilts to the left side.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation's annual sanitation inspection is expired. The last inspection was conducted on 10/22/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During investigation inspection, 1 out of the 5 classrooms were observed watching a movie during rest time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During investiagation inspection, 1 out of the 5 classrooms caregiver was observed on their personal cell phone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Supervised Naptime Daily: During investigation inspection, 1 out of 5 classrooms observed where not having naptime or a rest period.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervised Naptime Daily (26 TAC §746.2901)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: Caregiver in school age room was not follow written activity plan during investigation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Three of eight staff records did not contain the affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The operation last validated the background checks 11/9/2022.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Two of eight staff records did not contain proof of education.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One of eight records did not contain an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One student with an epi pen did not have the required allergy emergency plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The pea gravel located on the playground did not measure the required 6 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Corrections for peeling walls in the toddler, preschool and school age room were not received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 14 month old student was observed in a classroom with the oldest student being 5 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Walls in the toddler, preschool and school age room were observed to be peeling.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The pea gravel located on the playground did not measure the required 6 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the inspection conducted, the director is not operating the center in compliance by not following infant care requirements, allowing  classrooms out of ratio, and by not following minimum standards in the day-to-day operation of the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper mat located in the infant classroom is torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was in charge of five infants ages 4 months to 9 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: One infant was observed sleeping in a swing with a blanket.    SN: This was corrected when the caregiver removed the infant. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One of five infant feeding instructions was last updated 7/6/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A broken bucket and stand were broken on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: No Asphalt or Concrete Under Climbing Equipment Unless Unitary Surfacing Covers Use Zone: Cement was observed uncovered underneath a pole on a climbing structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Asphalt or Concrete Under Climbing Equipment Unless Unitary Surfacing Covers Use Zone (26 TAC §746.4601(8))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: The sink in the infant classroom is used to wash hands and bottles.     There was a bowl located in the hand washing sink at the diaper changing table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 1 out 8 children did not have current immunizations available on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose fill for the 2 playgrounds is less than the required depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The menu did not reflect what was served for lunch.     This was corrected when the asst. director recorded the substitues.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
